Folder conversion, texture atlases and map tile pyramids, all local and deterministic.

- **`convert -r`** converts whole directory trees, keeping relative paths under `-o`. It stops before writing if two inputs would produce the same output, and `--json` ends with a total line of files and bytes.
- **`codex-img atlas`** packs images into texture atlas pages with TexturePacker "hash" JSON for PixiJS and Phaser. `--trim` keeps the original size and offset in the JSON; `--padding`, `--extrude`, `--max-size`, `--pot` and `--prefix` are supported; extra pages are linked through `related_multi_packs`, so one `Assets.load` loads them all. The same inputs give byte-identical files.
- **`codex-img pyramid`** builds zoomed-out levels of a tiled map (`x_y` tiles such as TripleA's) on the same grid, with `--merge` for bigger tiles and a `pyramid.json` manifest. Edge tiles are cropped to `--map-size` and blank tiles are skipped.
- **`--version`** includes the commit for local builds (`0.9.0+3f3ed81`), so a recorded version names the exact build.
